title: History calibration updates real skills, not an eval-loop skill
prompt: Calibrate an existing repo-local skill from the next related historical commit group. Build a visible START and hidden oracle, replay current skills, compare first, and use skill-creator only for a reusable verified gap. In this case the replay failure is caused only by an omitted issue link while existing source/repo/workflow guidance is sufficient. Close the group correctly without creating an eval-loop skill or storing the commit answer in SKILL.md.

forbidden_patterns: create a new skill for this one failure
add a new template just in case
